_comment: OpenAI template. Copy to providers.json, export OPENAI_API_KEY holding your key, and verify the base_url and model ids against OpenAI's current docs. Public model names (left side of 'models') are what clients send after 'openai/'; the right side is the id OpenAI expects. Optional fields: cooldown_seconds (default 60), timeout_seconds (default 120), allow_insecure (default false).
